invariants.rationale: Array animationIntervals is actively used in the method, so it is likely that it should never be null at method entry.
The for loop assumes that animationIntervals has at least one element; otherwise, it would immediately throw an exception or not operate as intended.
The computation of currentTime uses loopDuration as a modulus; a zero or negative duration would result in incorrect behavior or exceptions.
Render times are typically expected to be non-negative values, especially if used in animation frame calculations.
